results.description: Intel just announced its first public stock sale since 1971. It's a $15 billion offering, following a near tripling of its share price in 2026. The bet is simple but risky. Today's AI compute demand needs to pay for tomorrow's chip factories. Intel is racing the clock to prove it can.
